verdict.rationale: Mollie documents an official hosted MCP server at https://mcp.mollie.com/mcp that proxies the public API across 13 APIs (Payments, Customers, Subscriptions, Payment Links, Balances, and others). It uses scoped Advanced access tokens and provides documented client configs for Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code via mcp-remote, and a probe confirms the official doc page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working, and coverage of APIs such as Refunds and Chargebacks, which are absent from the listed tool set.
